name: OPERA
summary: OPERA detected tau-neutrino appearance in the CERN-to-Gran-Sasso muon-neutrino beam by resolving the short-lived tau-lepton decay topology in a massive emulsion target.
physics_targets: Direct appearance of tau neutrinos through oscillation
detection_principle: Lead plates supplied neutrino interaction mass while nuclear-emulsion films provided micrometre-scale tracking. Electronic target trackers located candidate bricks, and magnetic spectrometers measured muons. Automated microscopy searched for tau decay kinks and detached vertices.
